ranked_results.content: We pre-processed the reports by setting their text content to lowercase and filtering out any non-alphanumeric characters. We used NLTK library to remove stopping words, e.g., `the', `an', `was', `if' and so on BIBREF10 . We then analyzed the reports to find common bigrams, such as “lung parenchyma”, “microscopic examination”, “lymph node” etc. We joined the biagrams with a hyphen, converting them into a single word. We further removed the words that occur less than 2% in each of the diagnostic category. As well, we removed the words that occur more than 90% across all the categories. We stored each pre-processed report in a separate text file.
